reuse.why: The change reuses budget writes, spreadsheet reads, batching and undo wrappers, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses the new shared category selector.

duplication.why: Fixed-group and income eligibility guards recur across actions, while copyPreviousMonth separately expresses the selector's hidden and template exclusions.

placement.why: Budget policy and actions remain in actions.ts, with typed method registration and undo integration in app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested bulk budget actions, their registration and associated tests.

maintainability.why: Eligibility remains split between SQL and individual action loops, requiring coordinated edits whenever the shared policy changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth uses getBudgetData and local eligibility guards instead of getBulkBudgetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth expresses hidden and saved-template exclusions as JavaScript guards while getBulkBudgetCategories expresses the same policy in SQL.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and its conditional SQL clause, but fixed-group and income exclusions remain in callers and copyPreviousMonth maintains a separate eligibility path.
